description: We are a team of enthusiastic students from SMK Sacred Heart. We believe in creativity, teamwork and innovation. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we hope to explore new ideas, develop our problem-solving skills and create innovative solutions to real-world challenges on Earth and in space. We are eager to learn, collaborate and make a positive impact on our world.
summary:
When the spacecraft crashes it should land in the center of the moon map. This means the players are stranded on the Moon with no way to get back to Earth. They must survive for a set amount of time—either 10, 20 or 30 days—while waiting for a rescue mission to arrive. During those days they need to explore the area around them gather resources like water, oxygen and food and slowly build a base on the Moon.

The base starts small. Grows step by step. First players must build the important buildings. These include living quarters to keep everyone safe oxygen systems to breathe power generators to run everything food production areas to avoid starvation and communication towers to stay in touch with Earth. Each building has a job. It helps the players stay alive longer and makes survival easier.

Survival is not simple. The mission is full of surprises. Players will face storms, equipment failures, dangerous terrain and other threats. These challenges test their teamwork. They need to think work together and make smart choices. If they fail to overcome any challenge the mission could fail. Every task must be completed successfully to keep things moving forward.

Once all goals are met—buildings are up resources are stable and communication is strong—the rescue team finally arrives. They pick up the surviving astronauts. Take them back, to Earth. The mission ends with a return. That is the goal. That is the end.
details:
1.Project Overview

Trailblazers is a fun and educating survival games designed for children aged 7-12 years old . It teaches children about moon exploration, survival tactics and the challenges astronauts may face while they are living on the moon

In this game, players take the role of astronaut whose spacecraft crashes on the moon and they have to survive for a short period about a month to be rescue and they have to build 6 moon bases to survive such as living quarters ,life support center ,water recycling center , research laboratory , power solution and exploration zone . There mission is to explore the moon and wait for rescue and survive the time wanting for the rescue . They must manage there limited resources and overcome unexpected challenges until the rescue team arrives to rescue them.

2.Project objectives

-teaches children to the challenges when living on the moon
-ways to overcome unexpected challenges
-encourage children to think ways to save themselves from unexpected challenges
-develop problem solving and critical solving skills
-help children understand the importance of oxygen, water and electricity
-encourages teamwork and decision making skills

3.Game play Description

Players begin their journey inside a spacecraft travelling to the moon . Suddenly during landing, the spacecraft experience a technical failure and crashes into the moon .Luckily , nobody want injured but their spacecraft was recked.

After the crash, player must explore their surrounding and collect resources to build 6 bases to help them survive until they get rescue.

4.Main Games features

-Base Building: construct bases such as living quarters , life support center, water recycling (also is greenhouse0 center , research laboratory , power station and exploration zone .
-Resources Management : Monitor oxygen ,water , food, electricity and building materials.
-Decision making : Choose how to respond to emergencies using limited resources.
-Mission Progression : Unlock new buildings ,technologies and achievements as the game progress
-Rescue Mission : Complete the survival mission and wait for the rescue team to arrive while building bases to rely on to survive

5.Target Audience

The game is designed for children aged 7-12 who are interested in astronomy , science ,space exploration, and interactive learning.

6.Educational Value

Trailblazers combines entertainment with STEM education. Players will learn how astronauts depend knowledge and careful resources management to survive in an extreme environment.

7.Expected outcome

By completing the mission, players will gain a better understanding of the difficults of establishing a human settlement on the moon and the importance of scientific innovation in future space exploration.
